description: Set all tracks targeted or untargeted. Useful before insert/overwrite edits. Reads back every affected track and reports verified only when all match the requested state.

targeted.description: Whether to target (true) or untarget (false) all tracks

track_type.description: Which track type(s) to affect (default: both)

name: set_all_tracks_targeted

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Set All Tracks Targeted
